hall.title: 안쪽 방 · 스무 자리
hall.image:
Korean romance-fantasy webtoon style, vertical composition. A long dim
hall receding upward into darkness, twenty floor cushions in two facing
rows running away from the viewer. Every cushion is taken — twenty
different fortune-tellers in hanbok, all ages and builds, each waiting
in their own posture. The four nearest sit at the vertical centre of
the frame and read clearly:
a composed young nobleman with cool distant eyes, black hair tied high
with a jade pin, deep indigo scholar's robe with silver trim;
a formidable old woman with a lined face and fierce clear eyes, white
hair in a tight knot, patched dark hanbok, a long smoking pipe resting
on her shoulder;
a striking woman in a loose crimson hanbok slipping off one shoulder,
hair falling free, a knowing half-smile;
a serene monk with long silver-white hair loose over one shoulder,
plain undyed hemp robe, eyes closed.
Behind them, half-read in the middle rows: a slender man in round
brass-rimmed spectacles bent over a ledger; a pale young woman in
gauzy lilac that seems to drift; a man with a lazy amused grin holding
a single card between two fingers; a woman with red thread wound
loosely round her fingers; a magnificent woman in richly embroidered
deep red with her arms crossed; a boy of about fourteen with sleeves
too long for his arms. The farthest rows are silhouettes only.
Above each cushion floats a small glowing flame-light in that reader's
own colour — amber, silver-blue, crimson, lilac, moss green, teal,
rose, muted gold — twenty colours, no two alike. Faces soften with
distance and the far end fades into shadow. Three ornate paper
lanterns hang overhead. Golden motes drift through the air. Deep
plum-violet shadows, mist along the floor. Quiet, expectant,
mysterious. No text. Aspect ratio 9:16.
